Although the Renegade favors medium to long-range engagements, it is no slouch when taking the fight inside. [[Raider]]s who are crouching and stationary can bullseye targets down range with a level of accuracy similar to the [[Osprey]]. Equipping the Renegade with a [[Silencer II]] or better deafens every shot enough to make it a great stealth weapon. Albeit, reloading is slow; every shell is loaded individually. Against ARC enemies, it's consistent damage and firerate makes it powerful for quickly taking out small, ground-based ARC (Such as [[Pop]]s) with precision. It's also able to quickly knock down poorly armored flying ARC, such as [[Wasp]]s with ease; its decent accuracy allows it to snipe the ARCs' thrusters off quickly. It instantly does poorly against enemies with large health pools and/or heavy armor, as its ARC Armor Penetration is not high enough to deal good damage to armor of those similar to [[Bastion]]s. Against Raiders, it becomes a deadly weapon that profits off long-range precision and makes sure that nobody can touch you if you play your cards right. It's highly accurate fire when standing still/crouching makes it powerful for throwing pot shots at enemies from afar, and it's fast fire rate allows it to overwhelm target near and far. With proper attachments, it's recoil and spread can also be lowered to be devastating in close ranges as well, but it's best to use this weapon at a distance where you gain an advantage, as close-range weapons such as the [[Vulcano]] can easily allow enemy Raiders to disarm you if they're close enough.
